_comment: Gallery images for the GREAT Greenland ROV site. To add a photo: commit the image file into this images/ folder, then add an entry to the list below. The gallery on the homepage renders these in order.

photos.caption: The team monitoring a dive from the ROV control cabin.

Flying Étaine from the pilot's console.
The team following the dive from the control container.
